# access.CreateApprovalRequestInput

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

Asks for approval of an action; the caller must hold its permission at the node.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `access.CreateApprovalRequestInput` |
| Kind | `command` |
| PII | `personal` |
| Tenancy scope | `organization` |

| `action` | yes | `personal` | The action to run once approved. |  |
| `node` | yes | `none` | Node where the action will run. |  |
| `permission` | yes | `none` | Permission of the action; it must require approval. |  |
